newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ROMARIO GETS $18 MILLION PRICE TAG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMARIO GETS $18 MILLION PRICE TAG.

text.p: Valencia president Francisco Roig has put a 2.8 billion peseta ($18 million) price tag on disgruntled Brazil striker Romario, a Spanish newspaper reported on Wednesday.
Spanish sports daily El Mundo Deportivo quoted Roig as saying: "Either he's here next Friday or it's 2.8 billion pesetas."
Roig suggested he would rather sell Romario than get involved in a protracted wrangle with the player who has a reputation for being difficult.
Romario, one of the stars of Brazil's recent Copa America triumph, on Monday expressed his reluctance to return to Spain and play for Valencia.
The player said he wanted to stay close to his sons and wanted them to live and be educated in Brazil.
A Valencia loan agreement with Brazilian club Flamengo runs out on July 20 and Valencia have indicated they would not extend it.
